parameters.name: AccessRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region from which the PrivateZone service is accessed.

You can call [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) to query region IDs.

parameters.name: HostRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the PrivateZone service resides.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
